title: TeraSim-World: Worldwide Safety-Critical Data Synthesis for End-to-End Autonomous Driving

control_signal.value: Location (coordinates, city and road type, or route), traffic demand level, adversity types (dynamic agent events, road construction, weather) injected by an adversity orchestrator, and street-view-derived text prompts.

control_mechanism.value: Pipeline: map and traffic retrieval, behaviour models plus adversity orchestrator and NADE for agent trajectories, rendered HDMap videos feed ControlNet branches of Cosmos-Drive with VLM text prompts for multi-view video.

base_model.value: Existing agent models (SUMO/CARLA rule-based, SMART, VBD) plus Cosmos-Drive video diffusion transformer (Cosmos-Transfer1-7B and Single2Multiview-7B) with ControlNet; GPT-4o writes scene prompts.

datasets.value: OpenStreetMap maps, TomTom live traffic, Google Street View, RDS-HQ camera setup; WOSAC-style Waymo-format behaviour models. No training or evaluation dataset for the pipeline itself stated.

controllability_evidence.value: Qualitative only: case studies (Ann Arbor roundabout, Mcity cases, five worldwide examples) show video motions following simulated trajectories and weather or roadwork variations; no quantitative number.

notes: Integration pipeline for sensor-level data synthesis, not a new controllable trajectory generator; no quantitative evaluation seen. Future work only: large synthesized dataset, multi-modal sensors, closed-loop AV testing (pages 6-8).
